name: Lanciano (Italy)
description: Purple field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Lanciano (a lance between a sun and fleurs-de-lis on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Lanciano, a comune in Abruzzo; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 7 March 2012.

features.role: Lanciano arms — lance between a sun and fleurs-de-lis on blue, crowned
